To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
intrinsic motivation and identified motivation mediate the impact of work design and leadership on job satisfaction, turnover intentions, and organizational citizenship behaviors.

intrinsic motivation and identified motivation are important mediators of the relationship of job characteristics with employee outcomes, and that identified motivation is an important mediator of the relationship of leadership and strategy with employee outcomes, but controlled motivation has little effect on employee outcomes.
intrinsic motivation and identified regulations mediate the impact of contextual factors on job satisfaction, turnover intentions, and organizational citizenship behaviors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the motivational processes that link antecedents of employee behavior to outcomes.

the motivational mechanisms through which work design, autonomy-supportive behavior, and organizational strategy influence employees' job satisfaction, turnover intentions, and organizational citizenship behaviors.
the question of how the job’s motivating characteristics, autonomy support, and strategy influence employee well-being and behavior in organizations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the impact of work design, autonomy support, and strategy on employee attitudes and behaviors is mediated by different types of self-determination.
the more self-determined an individual is, the more satisfied he or she will be with their job, the less likely he or she will leave, and the higher his or her OCB.

the more the employee feels that the organization is a supportive environment for him/her, the more the employee will be intrinsically motivated and the more he/she will feel identified with the organization.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the more employees are able to understand the organization’s strategy and are given autonomy support from their supervisors, the more they are motivated intrinsically and identified.
the more an individual is self-determined, the more likely they will be to be engaged in work.
self-determination is not a one-dimensional phenomenon, and that it should be considered in its different forms.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is important to consider the different motivational mechanisms at work and their unique characteristics in order to understand the impact of work design and leadership on employee outcomes.
the self-determination of behavior at work is a multi-faceted concept.

it is crucial to consider the motivational processes underlying the relationship between work design, autonomy supportive leadership, and organizational strategy and their impact on job satisfaction and turnover intentions.
